$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (landscape-application-components). Merges `partOf` onto `module`: the application this one is a component of, limited to applications of the same supplier (design D1), with the inverse `components` list. A component stays a `module`, so it keeps its own versions, usages, connections and standards. ModuleComponentListener refuses a module that would be part of itself or of one of its own components. Does NOT edit softwarecatalogus_register.json.

partOf.title: Part of
partOf.description: The application this one is a component of, such as the case system a portal belongs to.

components.title: Components
components.description: The applications that are a component of this one.
